description: List Meridian Dispatch's ranked World's Best places: the 10 best in the world or in one country, overall or within one category. Use it for "top things to do in X" or "best beaches in X". For one town's highlights use get_destination; for places near a point use list_nearby; for any other search use search_guides. Returns the list's title, the places in rank order (rank, name, where, a one-line summary, the place's own guide URL where one exists, and a coordinate), and, where the list is written as an article, its standfirst, a why_go paragraph per place and its close, the other categories available for that scope, and a citation. Read-only. A country or category with no list returns an error that names the ones that exist.

category.description: One kind of place: landmarks, museums, wilderness, hiking trails, scenic drives, parks, beaches, wildlife or ski resorts. Singular and plural both work. Omit for the overall list.

country.description: The country to rank, by English name, e.g. "Italy". Omit for the world list.

name: list_best_places

close.description: A written list: the closing paragraph.

why_go.description: A written list: why travel there, as the article says it.

source.description: How to credit this answer: show cite_as, or link url.

cite_as.description: A ready-made citation line: title, publisher, date and URL.

corrections.description: How to report an error on this page (suggest_edit).

url.description: Link for the reader (carries referral tags).

standfirst.description: A written list: the one-sentence idea that runs through it.

title.description: A written list: its article title.

title: List the World's Best places
